How does gender affect the effectiveness of public sector campaigns?

Another factor that can affect the effectiveness of a campaign is the time of year that the campaign is launched. For example, campaigns encouraging men to take paternity leave are often launched during family leave periods (e.g. during the summer months when many families are vacationing). This is because it is believed that men are more likely to take paternity leave when they are not focused on work and other commitments.

In conclusion, there are many factors that can affect the effectiveness of campaigns related to gender. One must consider the type of message, time of year, and media channels when designing a campaign.

After much debate, they settled on ordering a combination pizza with all their chosen toppings.
